strings.app.title: LogcatX
strings.devices.title: Devices
strings.devices.hint: Double-click a device row to start collection. Click a row to set the default drop target, then use More for the rest of the device actions.
strings.logs.hint: Review recent status messages, errors, and connection prompts in one place.
strings.log_files.title: Log files
strings.log_files.hint: Inspect the log directory, app log entry point, and current storage usage.
strings.log_files.empty: There are no files or folders to show in the current log directory yet.
strings.device.none_selected: Select a device to see the latest session details.
strings.device.status_card.title: Device connection is ready
strings.device.status_card.subtitle: You can start collection now or continue reviewing device info.
strings.connect.title: Connect a device
strings.connect.intro: Enter an endpoint such as `192.168.0.8:5555`, or reconnect from the recent list.
strings.drop.title: Choose a target device
strings.drop.intro: Select which connected device should receive the dropped files.
strings.drop.confirm_target: Files will be installed or transferred to: {device}
strings.drop.hover_hint: APK files will be installed. Other files will be copied to /sdcard/Download.
strings.alias.title: Edit device alias
strings.logcat_args.title: Edit logcat arguments
strings.logcat_args.hint: These extra arguments are appended after the adb logcat command. For example: -v threadtime -s WindowManager:V *:E
strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.intro: Confirm the adb executable, device log directory, and interface language.
strings.settings.explainer: Device logs are stored in the selected log directory. App runtime diagnostics are written to the embedded app log.
strings.settings.page_hint: Adjust the adb path, log directory, and interface language here. Changes apply immediately after saving.
strings.settings.adb.download_hint: ADB was not detected automatically. Download the official Android SDK Platform-Tools here:
strings.settings.language.help: On first run the default is chosen from the system language. Later launches follow the saved config.
strings.settings.mode.portable: Portable mode is active. Config and logs prefer the executable directory.
strings.settings.mode.appdata: AppData mode is active because the executable directory is not writable.
strings.clear.title: Clear historical logs
strings.clear.body: Delete all historical .log files under the configured log directory? Active capture files and the app runtime log will be preserved.
strings.status.initial_prompt: Please confirm the adb path, log directory, and language before using the app.
strings.status.initial_no_adb: No local adb executable was detected automatically. Please confirm the adb path before using the app.
strings.status.detected_adb: Detected local adb automatically: {path}. Please confirm the settings before use.
strings.status.device_list_auto_refreshed: Detected a device change and refreshed the list automatically.
strings.status.log_path_copied: Copied the latest log file path for {serial}.
strings.status.log_path_not_available: No log file available for {serial} yet.
strings.status.screenshot_copied: Copied the current screen from {serial} to the system clipboard.
strings.status.foreground_app_resolving: Resolving the current foreground app on {serial}...
strings.status.foreground_app_inspected: Resolved the current foreground app on {serial}: {app}
strings.status.foreground_app_action_started: Running "{action}" for the current foreground app on {serial}: {app}
strings.status.foreground_app_force_stopped: Force-stopped the current foreground app on {serial}: {app}. {message}
strings.status.foreground_app_data_cleared: Cleared data for the current foreground app on {serial}: {app}. {message}
strings.status.foreground_app_uninstalled: Uninstalled the current foreground app on {serial}: {app}. {message}
strings.status.drop_no_ready_device: Connect at least one ready device before dropping files.
strings.status.drop_no_supported_files: No local files were available to process from the drop operation.
strings.status.drop_busy: Wait for the current drop task to finish before starting another one.
strings.status.device_invalid_state: {serial} is currently {state} and cannot start logcat.
strings.status.finish_initial_setup: Finish the initial setup before starting collection.
strings.status.collector_exit_unexpected: Collector for {serial} exited unexpectedly with code {code}.
strings.status.alias_change_requires_idle: Stop the current capture for {serial} before changing its alias.
strings.status.device_pinned: Pinned {serial} to the top of the device list.
strings.status.config_load_error: Config could not be loaded; please confirm settings before use: {error}
strings.status.required_fields: ADB path and log directory are required.
strings.foreground.confirm.title: Confirm {action}
strings.foreground.confirm.body: You are about to {action} the current foreground app: {app}
strings.foreground.confirm.warning.force_stop: This stops the current foreground app immediately, but it can usually be launched again.
strings.foreground.confirm.warning.clear_data: This clears the app's local data and sign-in state, and is usually irreversible.
strings.foreground.confirm.warning.uninstall: This removes the app from the device and is a high-risk action.
strings.misc.click_to_open: Use the action buttons to open the related folder or file directly.
strings.update.auto_check_hint: Checks once in the background when the window is first opened after 08:00 local time. It never downloads or restarts automatically.
strings.update.downloaded: Update downloaded. Restart the app to apply it.
strings.update.not_configured: Application updates are not configured in this build.
strings.update.auto_check_failed_hint: The last automatic check failed. You can try again manually.
strings.update.demo_banner: Demo preview: this update is simulated locally (version {version}) and never contacts GitHub.
strings.status.update_downloaded: Update package for {version} has been downloaded and verified.
